title: Freeze scope and legal reuse boundary
exit_gate: All sources, versions, schema captures, licensing decisions and requirement mappings recorded. Unknown contracts and unlicensed artifacts block foundation approval.

title: Prove foundation and canonical identity/session boundaries
exit_gate: Pass identity collision/sharing, linking, embedded authentication, refresh concurrency and API adapter spikes. Select one authority through ADR-001; publish owned data and contract boundaries.

title: Complete authentication and session vertical slices
exit_gate: Every required password/passwordless/social/verification/session behavior passes positive, negative and concurrency tests; local delivery harness and an application integration work.

title: Complete linking, membership and permissions
exit_gate: Same-email, cross-tenant, verified/unverified link, unlink, role scope and access-propagation tests pass without inherited access escalation.

title: Complete factors, passkeys and recovery
exit_gate: Enrollment, step-up, recovery, factor removal, WebAuthn origin and replay tests pass with recent-authentication policy.

title: Complete enterprise, unified login and machine/agent auth
exit_gate: OIDC/SAML interoperability, multi-app logout, client lifecycle, resource audiences and MCP tool authorization pass under the frozen protocol profiles.

title: Complete local attack protection and CAPTCHA
exit_gate: All documented signal classes execute locally with quality/false-positive evidence, clear unknown states and enforcement tests; optional providers remain opt-in.

title: Complete customer/admin UI and plugins
exit_gate: All admin/profile/tenant/ban/plugin/UI flows pass role-boundary and accessibility tests. No platform function requires a vendor-hosted dashboard or paid seat.

title: Complete SDKs, integrations and migration
exit_gate: All original SDK/platform profiles build and pass qualification; integration examples and full migration/reconciliation/rollback evidence exist.

title: Qualify production operations and disaster recovery
exit_gate: Reproducible deployments, multiple replicas, load/failure tests, recovery, upgrades, redaction and no-auth-vendor-egress qualification pass.

title: Close full parity and independently review release
exit_gate: All required functional rows have implementation, tests and reviewed evidence; all 205 operations accounted; supported compatibility profiles explicit; exploitable critical/high findings remediated.
